description: Static connect options for MMIR.ai. These are safe frontend options only; secrets and provisioning belong to protected backend services.

options.title: Install Local Connector
options.description: Open the universal installer. It detects Mac, Windows, Linux/VM or Android client mode and gives the right MMIR Local Connector flow for local AI on 127.0.0.1:3000.

options.title: Connect local LLM
options.description: Use a local connector profile for models running on your PC or private VM. The connector pairs locally, discovers live models, routes chat through the MMIR API contract and can request an opt-in free tunnel when enabled locally.

options.title: Add compatible backend
options.description: Add a trusted MMIR-compatible backend URL for health, model discovery and chat once your connector/API follows the MMIR contract.

options.title: Use managed provider route
options.description: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and similar providers require api.mmir.ai, auth and a protected key vault. Do not paste real provider keys into the public frontend.
